title: Android
description: Android VPN, per-app routing and device settings. The core keeps running when the VPN is off.
unavailable: Android device settings are available only inside the yuhaiin Android app.

vpn.title: Android VPN
vpn.reconfiguring: Rebuilding the VPN interface. The core and other inbounds keep running.
vpn.mismatch: The TUN inbound setting and the VPN state differ. Check the error below or reconnect.
vpn.permissionRequired: Android must allow yuhaiin to create a VPN.
vpn.consentRequired: Review the VPN data disclosure in the app first.

settings.title: Android settings
settings.vpnHint: Changes to VPN settings rebuild the VPN interface without restarting the core.
settings.appendHTTPProxy: Advertise the HTTP proxy to apps
settings.autoConnect: Connect VPN after boot or update
settings.autoConnectHint: Requires VPN permission; nothing connects without it.
settings.notificationSpeed: Show traffic rate in the notification
settings.trackUnderlyingNetwork: Follow Wi-Fi and mobile network changes

coreBackgroundPolicy.while_needed: Only while the VPN or app is in use

perApp.title: Per-app VPN
perApp.hint: Applies to the Android VPN. Proxies and other inbounds are not affected.
perApp.consent: Listing installed apps needs your consent in the app.
